summary.en: Intas and its Accord businesses emphasize generics and biosimilars, combining internal capabilities with external partnerships. Xdivane is a verified investigational oncology biosimilar, while several other prominent Accord biosimilars are already approved.
summary.zh: Intas 及其 Accord 业务侧重仿制药和生物类似药,将内部能力与外部合作相结合。Xdivane 是经核实的在研肿瘤生物类似药,而 Accord 的其他几个知名生物类似药已获批。

ind.zh: 黑色素瘤(关键性对照研究)

next.en: Planned interim analysis in Q2 2027; FDA BLA submission targeted for mid-2027
next.zh: 计划于 2027 年第二季度进行中期分析;目标 2027 年中向 FDA 提交 BLA

watch.en: Xbrane’s Q3 report targets Xdivane interim analysis in Q2 2027 and a US BLA in mid-2027.
watch.zh: Xbrane 的第三季度报告目标为 2027 年第二季度完成 Xdivane 中期分析,并于 2027 年中提交美国 BLA。

watch.en: Intas conducts clinical development and Accord handles global commercialization of Xdivane.
watch.zh: Intas 负责 Xdivane 的临床开发,Accord 负责其全球商业化。

watch.en: Intas assumed financing for certain Xdivane CMC development costs, offset against future profit sharing with an 18% mark-up.
watch.zh: Intas 承担了 Xdivane 部分 CMC 开发成本的融资,并以 18% 的加成与未来利润分成相抵。

watch.en: Accord’s 2026 news records approvals or launches for filgrastim, pegfilgrastim, golimumab and denosumab biosimilars.
watch.zh: Accord 2026 年的消息记录了 filgrastim、pegfilgrastim、golimumab 和 denosumab 生物类似药的获批或上市。

gaps: No published company-wide phase totals were verified; counts is null. Unverified mechanisms, modalities, origins, codes and next milestone dates are null.

Intas is private; no public quarterly financial report or full named phase-by-phase group pipeline was verified. The Intas corporate R&D and operations pages timed out; curl fallback failed because DNS was unavailable. Accord company pages and partner releases were used.
The selected programme is described as pivotal/registration-enabling, but the loaded Xbrane materials do not explicitly number its phase. Phase is null rather than equating pivotal with Phase 3.

Only one eligible investigational asset was verified. Approved biosimilars are not recycled as pipeline candidates. Bio-Thera’s BAT2506 India rights were announced, but no current Indian filing/clinical stage or major new indication was verified, so it is omitted.

Accord’s pipeline-growth graphics refer to January 2024, older than June 2026, and do not disclose current named assets. The 2027 timeline is a partner forecast, not an approved filing date or guaranteed launch.

Final curl -sSIL checks were attempted for every cited URL on 2026-11-17. All 57 unique URLs returned HTTP 000 with curl exit 6 because this environment could not resolve hosts. Browser-loaded sources support the entries, but independent HTTP-status verification could not be completed.
